citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:19am on July 1,
2026. The inspectors attempted to contact the licensee/registrant by phone at 11:19am and 11:48am and sent a text
message at 11:21am. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the
AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
Additional Inspectors:
